347 days = 1 year (1292 is a leap year? 1292 ÷ 4 = 323, yes, leap year) minus 18 days?  
347 = 366 - 19 → actually 347 days from Jan 27, 1291:  
First, add 1 year: Jan 27, 1292 (366 days later because 1292 is leap year).  
But we only need 347 days, so 366 - 347 = 19 days before Jan 27, 1292.  
Jan 27, 1292 minus 19 days = Jan 8, 1292.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1292-01-08
